settings.heading: Settings
settings.lede: Change how the app looks, go back to setup, or start over. Nothing here changes your progress unless you choose a reset and confirm it.
settings.text_size_intro: Makes all the text in the app larger or smaller. Your choice is kept in this browser only.
settings.setup_intro: Setup opens on its own full page, one check at a time. Open it to run the checks again, change your AI command, or finish setup at any time.
settings.reset_intro: Each reset asks you to confirm first. What it clears is moved to a backup folder, not deleted, except the answer key.

banner.label: Setup reminder
banner.text: Setup is not finished, so exercises that use your AI are off. You can still read every lesson.

setup_gate.cli_exercise: This exercise uses your AI, so it needs setup first.
setup_gate.step: This step uses your AI, so it needs setup first.
setup_gate.preview_lesson: You are reading ahead. Setup is not finished, so the exercises here are off and nothing you do here is saved.
setup_gate.preview_step: You are reading ahead. Setup is not finished, so nothing in this step can be started yet.
setup_gate.preview_lesson_after: You are reading ahead. This lesson opens after you finish "{title}", so the exercises here are off and nothing you do here is saved.
setup_gate.preview_step_after: You are reading ahead. This step opens after you finish "{title}", so nothing in it can be started yet and nothing is saved.

progress.summary: Start the course again from the first item. Your setup stays.
progress.title: Reset lesson progress?
progress.lead: The course starts again from its first item.
clears: All lesson and step progress, your baseline and your review schedule.
Everything the app and your AI made during the course: the checker, fixtures, saved runs, saved results and the iteration log.
The answer key, if you made one. It is deleted and is not backed up.
keeps: Your setup, your AI command, your track and your project folder.
Your starting prompt and test cases, and every other file in your project folder.
Text size, theme and sidebar choices.
progress.backup: What is cleared is moved to one backup folder, not deleted: {folder}. It replaces the previous backup.
progress.no_project: No project has been set up yet, so there are no files to clear. Only any earlier lesson progress is cleared, and no backup is made.
progress.done: Lesson progress was cleared. The files that were cleared are in the backup folder: {folder}.
progress.done_no_backup: Lesson progress was cleared. There were no files to back up.

configuration.summary: Return the app to how it was the first time you opened it. This also clears your lesson progress.
configuration.title: Reset app configuration?
configuration.lead: The app goes back to its first-run state. This also clears all lesson progress.
clears: All lesson progress, exactly as Reset lesson progress does.
Your setup results, your AI command, your track and the remembered project.
Your starting prompt and test cases and the bundled skill files in your project folder.
Text size, theme and sidebar choices in this browser. They go back to their defaults.
The answer key, if you made one. It is deleted and is not backed up.
keeps: The tools downloaded for the app, so setup can pass again without downloading.
Every other file in your project folder.
configuration.backup: What is cleared is moved to one backup folder, not deleted: {folder}. It replaces the previous backup.
configuration.no_project: No project has been set up yet. Only the saved setup is cleared, and no project files are touched.
configuration.done: The app configuration was reset. The files that were cleared are in the backup folder: {folder}. Setup starts again.
configuration.done_no_backup: The app configuration was reset. There were no files to back up. Setup starts again.

errors.confirm_required: Nothing was changed. This needs your confirmation first.
errors.job_busy: Nothing was changed. The app is still checking or installing something for setup. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.backup_failed: Nothing was changed. The backup could not be made: {error}. Check that the app's storage folder can be written to and has free space, then try again.
errors.key_failed: Nothing was changed. The answer key could not be deleted: {error}.
errors.reset_failed: Nothing was changed. The reset could not finish: {error}.
errors.scaffold_failed: The files were cleared and backed up, but the app could not set up the empty course folders: {error}. Open Settings and run setup again.
